title: ononis mauritanica
intro: Ononis mauritanica, commonly known as Spiked Restharrow, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ononis mauritanica include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
